title: origanum vulgare subsp. virens
intro: Origanum vulgare subsp. virens, commonly known as Golden Oregano, is a subspecies of the sweet marjoram plant. It is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region, prized for its medicinal and culinary properties. The health benefits of Golden Oregano include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful for treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Golden Oregano include carvacrol, thymol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties.
